project.title: Movies Under the Stars
project.description: Four outdoor movie nights at Nightcliff foreshore showing films from students' home countries, each introduced by a student from that country. The club will buy two Bluetooth speakers and a portable projector and keep them for future club events.
project.who_can_attend: Open to all international students studying in the Northern Territory. Entry is free.
project.wellbeing_benefit: Social connection and wellbeing for international students.
